diagnosis: MG15 mission-conditioned Go, Ygg and conventional selected action 2 in all 576 original DoorKey steps across 3 seeds; both native 0/3 DoorKey, 3/3 Empty; blind conventional 1/3 DoorKey. Positive mission-global action preference suppressed source-public contextual policy.
hypothesis: Mission reward evidence may override source-public native successor action only after genuine positive and terminal selected action from identical complete original public mission+image+direction state.

policy.true_state_key: SHA256 of canonical genuine original public image 7x7x3, direction and mission
policy.parent: Go DK16 wraps unchanged DK14, Ygg R20 wraps unchanged R18. Bypass global mission-action reward override at choice via unchanged DK13/R17 source successor actor on internally projected legacy input. Parent remains unchanged and receives all source-selected FIT and live events.
policy.ledger: Per exact original public state and selected action count + positive count. Positive requires source_reward>0, terminated=true and changed original public state (before != after). No hallucinated unchosen outcomes, hidden pose, manual stage, fixed action meaning, answer oracle, tokeniser or transformer.
policy.selection: Only exact-context actions with positive>0 can override: score=floor(4096*positive/(count+64)); highest wins, ties by ascending legal action. Otherwise delegate exactly to original source-public successor actor and preserve its native selection status. Nonmatching states and missions get zero reward-specific credit.
